question: How is the figure on the moon-seat to be visualized in relation to the moon above?
premises: One meditates on a figure seated on a moon-seat.
The figure is struck or touched by the moon above.
inference: The meditator should visualize the figure on the moon-seat as touched by the moon above.
plain_english: Having meditated on him seated on a moon-seat, one should visualize him touched by the moon above.
